method: isolated memory storage; real purchaseGrowth, InventoryStore, SaveManager and beginRun
checks: purchase moves the existing passive, preserves every item and saves one complete record before notification
empty passive slot remains empty, active tools stay in place and the new active slot can be used
rejected storage restores slots, resources, growth, stability, forecast and original item references
insufficient funds and maxed purchases leave inventory and all base state unchanged
occupied destination fails without displacing either item or partially buying the upgrade
catalog whole-run passive keeps identity and uses during purchase, then consumes exactly once on real departure
old expanded base records repair once, preserve item payloads and can depart after repeated reload
old-record repair remains usable after a rejected migration write and retry never replenishes items
active and unfinished-return records keep original equipment and bytes unchanged
limitations: No player visual acceptance or browser input is claimed.
